data.name: Ultra-high-vacuum chamber
data.function: Stainless octagon with viewports holding the trap at 1e-11 mbar. Collisions with background gas eject or heat ions, so pressure sets the chain lifetime; the chamber is baked and ion-pumped and often cooled to 4 K in newer systems to lower pressure further.

physics.summary: UHV environment; pressure sets chain lifetime.

data.tooltip: UHV chamber holding the ion trap.
